entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

-----
 For the Appellant : Mr. Akhouri Awinash Kumar, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Bhola Nath Ojha, A.P.P.

For the Res. No.2 : Mr. Abhay Kumar Mishra, Advocate  ---
06/15.03.2024 Appellant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Gumla SC/ST P.S. Case No. 06 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)(n), 417, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)
(i), 3(1)(w)(ii) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Gumla.
It is alleged that the opposite party no.2 was in consensual physical relationship with the appellant.
Subsequently the appellant refused to marry her.
It is alleged that when the opposite party no.2 went to the house of the appellant, he abused her using derogatory caste related words.

Mr. Akhouri Awinash Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant submitted that no case of SC/ST Act will be made out because the allegation of having used derogatory caste related words was inside the house of the appellant and not at the public place.
It was further submitted that the opposite party No.2 was in consensual physical relationship with the appellant since last several years.
Mr. Abhay Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 has opposed the prayer for bail.
However he conceded that the occurrence had taken place inside the house of the appellant.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid fact, the appellant, above named, is directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of this order and the learned court below shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees twenty-five thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Gumla in connection with Gumla SC/ST P.S. Case No. 06 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
